strategy_question: How should the bounded VALI KE / PARAZAMI KE source be allocated across the ten unnamed foundational OPI positions without inventing canonical slot identity or authoring content prematurely?

routes.name: SEQUENTIAL_SINGLE_POSITION_ALLOCATION_WITH_EXPLICIT_CONTENT_GATE
routes.reason: Allocate at most one unnamed structural position at a time, beginning with internal selector 1 only after a separate explicit allocation/content decision; preserves provenance and avoids bulk authoring.

routes.name: ALLOCATE_PAIR_TO_ALL_TEN_POSITIONS_NOW
routes.reason: Would over-propagate two bounded realizations across the full OPI target without per-position evidence or authoring decisions.

routes.name: CREATE_CANONICAL_SLOT_IDS_BEFORE_ALLOCATION
routes.reason: Would invent canonical identity not supported by the current source lock.

constraints: No position is assigned in strategy selection.
Internal selector 1 is only a noncanonical structural index, never a canonical slot ID.
No OPI text authoring or validation in strategy selection.
Existing source mapping stays closed to VALI KE and PARAZAMI KE.
No QA/STR003-STR005/runtime action and no KE generalization.
